texts.zh:
[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对我方[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot]，[event_envoy.GetName]，在[event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]的所作所为表达了深切的不满。显然[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的行为冒犯了当地的[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，政府机构不得不派出护卫来保证[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的个人安全。由于我们缺乏[envoy_country.GetAdj]的那种多愁善感，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]具体做了什么还不得而知，但是在[event_envoy.GetSheHe]预计要演讲的地方，出现了大量的反对[event_envoy.GetHerHim]本人以及反对“[Root.GetAdj]的傲慢无礼”的抗议活动。

[envoy_country.GetName]勒令我方召回[event_envoy.GetName]，并派遣一名新的大使替代[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的职位。他们暗示，如果我方拒绝，会造成外交后果。
texts.en:
The [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have brought forward a complaint regarding the conduct of our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation], [event_envoy.GetName]. Apparently [event_envoy.GetHerHis] conduct has so offended the local [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that their authorities have posted a guard for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] own protection. Exactly what [event_envoy.GetSheHe] did is unclear to us, as we lack [envoy_country.GetAdj] sensibilities, but there are widespread protests against [event_envoy.GetHerHim] and the "[Root.GetAdj] arrogance" [event_envoy.GetSheHe] supposedly represent[event_envoy.GetSXX].

The [envoy_country.GetName] urges us to recall [event_envoy.GetName] and send a new ambassador in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] place. They hint at diplomatic repercussions should we refuse.

# 大使的失足 / Missteps from an Ambassador

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/envoy_events.txt:2425-2556`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

Galactic Community 特使的随机事件：五年脉冲（action.2211）的负面列表 on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list，权重见分支栏（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592）；on_action 会先检查事件触发条件、不满足的从列表中剔除，所以只要有一个能触发就必有一个触发。通常共用5400天的 recent_envoy_event 冷却。 本事件：非集群（或对方为非原始文明），特使不是“受尊敬使节”，驻在某国；无 recent_envoy_event；权重10/180。

A random Galactic Community envoy event: the negative list of the five-year pulse (action.2211), on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list, weights in the branches (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592); on_actions check each event's trigger first and drop the failing ones, so as long as any can fire one always does. Most share a 5400-day recent_envoy_event cooldown. This event: Non-gestalt (or the host is non-primitive), the envoy is not a "respected" envoy and is posted to a country; no recent_envoy_event; weight 10 of 180.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

被驻在国投诉特使冒犯其规范。选项一：保留特使（驻在国观感 opinion_envoy_insult_taken；排外/嗜杀者获得每月凝聚力加成）；选项二：召回重训（特使进入惩罚冷却）。

The host country complains that the envoy violated its norms. Option one: keep the envoy (the host's opinion modifier opinion_envoy_insult_taken; xenophobes or homicidal empires also gain a monthly unity bonus); option two: recall for retraining (the envoy enters a punishment cooldown).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

二选一；AI 只对排外/嗜杀者倾向保留。

One of two; the AI favours keeping only for xenophobes or homicidal empires.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

选项文本分排外/集群与其他。

Option text differs for xenophobe / gestalt and others.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了脚本触发和选项；与同一列表中的其他事件互相独立。

Trigger and options were checked against the script; independent of the other events in the same list.
